casts.name: Drained
casts.shows: The explaining continues and the basin is dry.
casts.image: ☵ water beneath ☱ lake. The water has gone out from under the lake and the bed is showing.
casts.situation: Exhaustion. The old text gives a stark warning about speech, saying that words spoken now will land badly. What it counsels instead is persistence held privately, because these conditions will outlast any argument made against them.

casts.name: Reserves
casts.shows: You have been storing this and never named the day.
casts.image: ☰ heaven beneath ☶ mountain. The whole creative force held under a mountain and kept there.
casts.situation: Great accumulation. A large power restrained by something larger, so the holding builds it instead of souring it. The old counsel says to eat away from home and that crossing the great water is favourable, which reads as an instruction: the store was built for elsewhere, and now is when to spend it.

becomes.name: Spring
becomes.shows: This is rising, and the window has an edge on it.
becomes.image: ☱ lake beneath ☷ earth. Two firm lines rising at the base, with the ground open above them.
becomes.situation: Something is coming up and there is room above it. The old text puts a date on it, saying trouble arrives in the eighth month, which turns the reading into a clock: this is favourable and it is favourable now. Spring approaches, and the approach is the whole of it.

casts.name: Nightfall
casts.shows: You are keeping a light covered, and it is still lit.
casts.image: ☲ fire beneath ☷ earth. The sun gone under the ground, with its light still inside the figure.
casts.situation: The light is wounded and continues. The old reading gives a wise person under a bad ruler who keeps their brightness by covering it, and the counsel is to know the difficulty and stay firm inside it.

becomes.name: Muster
becomes.shows: What would organise this is a fact you have not said.
becomes.image: ☵ water beneath ☷ earth. One firm line among five yielding ones, holding the whole figure to a shape.
becomes.situation: Water stored underground: a resource that is present, invisible, and organised. The single strong line is the discipline that turns a crowd into a force. The old warning is that this works with an experienced hand and a clear cause, and the same gathering under any other conditions is a mob.

casts.name: Vigour
casts.shows: Force is available here and unaimed.
casts.image: ☰ heaven beneath ☳ thunder. Four firm lines have risen and the entire lower half of the figure is force.
casts.situation: Great power at the moment it becomes available and before it has anywhere to go. The old image is a ram butting a hedge and catching its horns, which is what unaimed strength does. The counsel is about propriety, so the question the figure asks is where you point it.

becomes.name: Burning
becomes.shows: You keep saying the same true sentence, and it is consuming its subject.
becomes.image: ☲ fire beneath ☲ fire. A yielding line held between two firm ones, twice over, and the whole figure is light.
becomes.situation: Fire exists by holding to what it burns, which is why the character carries both brightness and clinging. The old counsel is to care for the cow — the docile thing that keeps producing. Radiance here is maintained by feeding it.

casts.name: Measure
casts.shows: You are past what you can hold and you have not said where the edge is.
casts.image: ☱ lake beneath ☵ water. A lake with more water above it than the basin holds.
casts.situation: The character is the joint of a bamboo, the node that divides the stalk into lengths and makes it strong. Limitation as structure. The old text warns at once against bitter limitation, since a rule too harsh to keep gets broken and takes the rest of them with it.

becomes.name: Footing
becomes.shows: You are stepping onto ground that matters, and the play is what makes it safe.
becomes.image: ☱ lake beneath ☰ heaven. A small soft thing placed directly under the largest hard one.
becomes.situation: The old line is about treading on a tiger's tail and coming away whole, which happens through the quality of the step. Conduct is the entire content here. Where you put your weight, in what order, at what speed, decides whether the ground holds.

casts.name: Household
casts.shows: An arrangement has formed here without being discussed.
casts.image: ☲ fire beneath ☴ wind. Fire making its own draught, with the wind coming out of the flame.
casts.situation: The family. The old text begins with correctness inside the house and works outward, and the commentary's point is structural: positions held properly within produce order without. Wind out of fire — what happens in here goes out there.

becomes.name: Feeding
becomes.shows: What this gives you is feeding you, uncounted.
becomes.image: ☳ thunder beneath ☶ mountain. Two firm lines at top and bottom with four open ones between them: a mouth.
becomes.situation: The figure is a jaw and the subject is what goes into it. The old text says to look at what a person nourishes, and at what they seek to fill their own mouth with, and offers this as a way of reading someone. Movement below and stillness above, because the lower jaw does the work.
